\section{Evidence filtering}
The main analysis counts every schema-valid edge, whether or not its evidence quote matches the source. Here the report-conditioned kernels are rebuilt without edges whose quotes fail the fragment-aware check (the check described in the paper) or a strict whole-span check. B and ATTK kernels are unaffected. Each table shows the adopted value beside the filtered one.

\section{Ground-truth variants}
Two alternative readings of the plans, each scored with the same kernels. Variant B treats menuPass's two steps marked Optional (8.A and 7.1) as separate segments, which leaves the plan four edges. Variant A splits OilRig and Sandworm at every Linux/Windows handoff (OilRig 15 $\to$ 12 edges, Sandworm 21 $\to$ 19). Neither is adopted.
